sentence_stem: Because the park is close to my house,
full_sentence: Because the park is close to my house, I go there every weekend.
acceptable_variants: I walk there with my dog.
I play football there with my friends.

options.text: although it is very far away.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' shows contrast, but the stem gives a reason, so the completion must follow a cause, not oppose it.
This gives a result that contradicts the reason in the stem, so the sentence does not make sense as a logical continuation.

options.text: the park has a big lake.
options.why_wrong: This adds a description of the park, but it does not complete the reason-result structure started by 'because'.

explanation: After 'because', the sentence gives the reason, and the main clause gives the result. The result should follow naturally from the reason in the first part of the sentence.
translation: Como el parque está cerca de mi casa, voy allí todos los fines de semana.
